message.content:
**Fastest Route from New York City to Boston (by car)**  

| Leg | From | To | Distance | Approx. Time | Notes |
|-----|------|----|----------|--------------|-------|
| 1 | New York City (NYC) | New York‑Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~10 mi | 15 min | Start on I‑95 N toward the New Jersey Turnpike. |
| 2 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~70 mi | 1 h 10 min | Continue on I‑95 N through NJ, crossing the George Washington Bridge into Manhattan. |
| 3 | Manhattan | I‑95 N (New York‑Jersey Turnpike) | ~5 mi | 10 min | Take the exit onto I‑95 N toward the New Jersey Turnpike. |
| 4 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~120 mi | 2 h | Keep on I‑95 N through NJ, passing Newark, Trenton, and Princeton. |
| 5 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~60 mi | 1 h | Continue on I‑95 N through NJ, crossing the Delaware River into Pennsylvania. |
| 6 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~80 mi | 1 h 20 min | Keep on I‑95 N through PA, passing Harrisburg and Reading. |
| 7 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | ~70 mi | 1 h 10 min | Continue on I‑95 N through PA, crossing the New York state line. |
| 8 | New Jersey Turnpike (I‑95 N) | I‑93 N (Boston) | ~70 mi | 1 h 10 min | Merge onto I‑93 N toward Boston. |
| 9 | I‑93 N | Boston (Downtown) | ~10 mi | 15 min | Follow I‑93 N into Boston, then take the appropriate exit for your destination. |

**Total Distance:** ~500 mi  
**Estimated Driving Time:** ~6 hours (traffic‑dependent)

### Quick Directions

1. **Start** on I‑95 N (New York‑Jersey Turnpike) from NYC.  
2. **Continue** on I‑95 N through New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and into New York State.  
3. **Merge** onto I‑93 N toward Boston once you cross the New York state line.  
4. **Follow** I‑93 N into Boston; exit at your desired location.

### Tips

- **Traffic:** Peak traffic times (weekday mornings/evenings) can add 30–60 minutes.  
- **Tolls:** I‑95 N in New Jersey and the New York‑Jersey Turnpike have tolls; consider an E‑ZPass.  
- **Alternate Route:** If you prefer a scenic drive, take I‑87 N (Massachusetts Turnpike) after I‑95 N, but it’s typically slower.  

Enjoy your trip!
